overview: The Medford School Committee approved revisions to the vocational technical education admissions policy and recognized several science fair award winners. The committee also debated potential adjustments to the 2026-2027 school calendar to better accommodate holiday observances and professional development needs.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved routine items including bills, payroll, donations, and meeting minutes from April 6, 2026.

items.title: Mustang Moment: Science Fair Awardees
items.summary: Director of Science Rocco Cieri introduced student winners of the annual science fair, who presented research on topics ranging from acoustic resonance to static electricity.

items.title: CTE Program Admissions Policy Update
items.summary: Approved revisions to the Chapter 74 Vocational Technical Education admissions policy to satisfy Department of Elementary and Secondary Education requirements regarding lottery procedures and student retainment.

items.title: FY 2026-2027 Calendar Review
items.summary: The committee discussed potential revisions to next year's calendar due to a late Labor Day start and staffing challenges observed on Good Friday; the Superintendent will seek community input before returning with a formal proposal.

items.title: Summary of Objectives Review
items.summary: Tabled the review of the summary of objectives from the January retreat.

items.title: School Committee Rules Revisions
items.summary: Members conducted a line-by-line review of proposed updates to the committee's rules, focusing on renumbering, meeting frequencies, and administrative deadlines; the item was referred to the next meeting for final consolidation.
